headline: Lowell Cultural Council revises FY27 grant guidelines and tables Lowell Artisan Market program to next meeting.
summary: The council reviewed and edited its Local Guidelines for 2027 line by line, including removing reimbursement language, setting a Jan 1–Dec 31, 2027 project window, and an Oct 15 application deadline, for submission to the Mass Cultural Council. The Lowell Artisan Market Council Initiated Program for 2026 was tabled to a future meeting, possibly Spring 2027. The council also planned to move the September 22 council meeting to 5:30 PM followed by a grantee reception at 6:30 PM, and reviewed and signed reimbursement requests.
decisions: Tabled the Lowell Artisan Market Council Initiated Program for 2026 to a future meeting, possibly Spring 2027.
Moved the September council meeting to 5:30 PM on September 22, immediately followed by the grantee reception at 6:30 PM.

decision_evidence.quote: Tabled to next meeting, potentially Spring 2027
The September council meeting (Tuesday, September 22) will be moved up to 5:30 PM and immediately followed by the grantee reception at 6:30 PM.
